# build-development

Development website build skills: the dev handoff index and GO / NO-GO gate.

Installing it also installs: [`build-shared`](../build-shared/README.md).

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`dev-handoff-index`](skills/dev-handoff-index/SKILL.md) | Builds a website's dev handoff index and says which pages dev can start. |

## Install

```
/plugin marketplace add tidycatc132/claude-skills
/plugin install build-development@wise-skills
```
